title: Privacy Stack 3/4 - strong ad and tracker filtering
description: Apply the backed-up Balanced-Strong Pi-hole filtering baseline when management SSH is available. If Pi-hole management SSH/key is unavailable, preserve the working GUI and DNS visibility and finish this chapter successfully in DEGRADED_READ_ONLY mode with write policy pending.
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$rp=Get-Content 'C:/3EN-Agent/router-pihole-final/state.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$r=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/status' -TimeoutSec 12;if(-not $r.pihole.dns){throw 'Pi-hole DNS unhealthy'};$full=([bool]$rp.piSsh -and [bool]$rp.piKey);if(-not $full){Write-Host 'PRIVACY_FILTER_TEST=PASS_DEGRADED;MANAGEMENT_MODE=DEGRADED_READ_ONLY;WRITE_POLICY=PENDING_MANAGEMENT_SSH';return};if(-not $r.pihole.blocking){throw 'filtering disabled'};if([int64]$r.pihole.gravity -lt 10000){throw 'gravity too small'};$l=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/adlists' -TimeoutSec 12;$a=@($l.items|Select-Object -ExpandProperty address);if($a -notcontains 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists/main/domains/pro.txt'){throw 'Pro list missing'};if($a -notcontains 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists/main/domains/tif.txt'){throw 'TIF list missing'};Write-Host ('PRIVACY_FILTER_TEST=PASS;MANAGEMENT_MODE=FULL;GRAVITY='+$r.pihole.gravity)
rollback: Write-Host 'Filter backend preserves timestamped gravity.db backups under /var/backups/3en-security-privacy when write management is available.'
